title: GNW predicts prefrontal ignition at stimulus onset and offset

statements.text: The maintenance of a conscious percept is carried by transient prefrontal ignitions at stimulus onset and at stimulus offset, updates to conscious perception, with virtually no activity between them.
statements.conditions: Preregistered by the Cogitate adversarial collaboration with Stanislas Dehaene as the GNW proponent. The OSF project osf.io/mbcfy was created 2019-01-16, and the protocol states the preregistration and its amendments were frozen before data acquisition. The exact freeze date is not stated in the open protocol.

prediction.resolution_criterion: Intracranial recordings in prefrontal regions of interest show an onset and an offset response tracking stimulus duration, the GNWT temporal profile.

standing.reason: Preregistered test: none of 655 prefrontal electrodes showed the onset and offset profile, confirmed by Bayesian analysis.

sources.quote: GNW predicts ignitions within PFC following stimulus onset and possibly also during stimulus offset, constituting updates to conscious perception
